title: Basal ganglia and cerebellum compute outside the conscious loop

statements.text: Subcortical and cortical processing that does not involve layer 5 pyramidal neurons stays unconscious. Motor control computed in the basal ganglia and cerebellum is detached from the loop of consciousness, though their outputs can enter it through thalamus and cortex.

sources.quote: motor control is based on the computations of basal ganglia and cerebellum, which are detached from the loop of consciousness
